digest.component_or_area: LLM failure classification / context-length hint tuple
propositions: The eight-phrase _CONTEXT_LEN_HINTS tuple is duplicated byte-for-byte in failure.py:148-157 and sizing.py:316-329, creating a maintenance hazard where fixes to one silently leave the other stale.

sizing.is_context_limit_error must remain a def in plan_review/sizing.py because orchestrator.py imports it at module load time and test_plan_review_prerequisites_model_log.py monkeypatches it by string name.
Importing _CONTEXT_LEN_HINTS from failure.py into sizing.py introduces no import cycle and preserves the boundary constraint that failure.py depends only on rebar.llm.errors.

completion_failures.py:46-79 defines a deliberately different _is_token_exhaustion classifier that omits the bare 'context' substring and keys off finish_reason, making it not suitable for consolidation.

A uniqueness guard must verify that the eight-phrase conjunction appears in exactly one definition location under src/rebar (excepting the owner failure.py), and must flag when a second copy is introduced.
